text: Review from someone who is extremely terrified of dentists! I hesitated for 3 years until I found this place. The dentist was very gentle, and the staff were lovely. They talked to me and encouraged me, which eased my anxiety. Someone told me that tooth extraction would be very painful, making it impossible to eat or sleep. That wasn't true at all! I ate well and slept comfortably. The anesthetic injection wasn't painful at all; even a fever reducer injection hurts more! It wasn't scary at all, unlike what I'd heard. The staff were kind, supportive, and comforting, helping me overcome my fear. If you're someone who's afraid of dentists, I highly recommend this place. I was very impressed. If you're looking for a good clinic, I highly recommend this one. 10/10"
